detected_fault.failure_mode: Screen Blacking Out After Sleep Mode
symptoms: Screen stays black with a faint glow.
Pink lines appear while playing videos in browser or local video player.

suggested_solution.failure_mode: Screen Blacking Out After Sleep Mode
solution: Run a stress test on the display to identify any potential hardware issues.
Check for any firmware updates for the display panel and consider updating them.
Run a stress test on the graphics card to identify any potential hardware issues.
Adjust the refresh rate to 60Hz from 40Hz to see if it resolves the issue.
Consider updating GPU drivers for AMD Radeon and NVIDIA GTX 1650.
